notes.quote: Questions 1,3, 5,6 and 8 provided a useful source of marks for many.

Centres should take note that questions on proof are still being found difficult.
Question 4(a) was not well attempted and many candidates failed to show sufficient working on 8(a).
Points to note for candidates in future WMA11 series are:
• failing to add + c when integrating will lead to the loss of a mark
• read questions more carefully and sketch a diagram if it will help (Qu 2)
• pay attention to questions where calculators are not allowed (Qu 4)
• ensure that you show sufficient working to make your method clear
• be careful when sketching curves, show the key aspects of the curve
• label parts carefully and answer the question that is being asked (Qu 10)
